digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport outbound differ
propositions: Outbound differ returns empty string for unassigned local assignee, but DC transport passes it verbatim to pycontribs JIRA.assign_issue instead of routing through unassign
pycontribs JIRA._get_user_id does not treat empty string as unassign sentinel; it calls search_users(user='') which either raises or assigns an arbitrary user match
Cloud transport already implements the fix by routing empty/None assignee through unassign_issue, but DC transport never received the equivalent branch
DC transport _assign method must map falsy assignee to None before calling assign_issue to produce the correct unassign payload (PUT {name: null})
Test test_outbound_unassign_round_trips expects fields.assignee to be null after local assignee clear, but fails because empty string reaches assign_issue unguarded
